name: AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
memory_note: 16 GB GDDR6 (RX 7800 XT, gfx1101, 60 CUs, 624 GB/s peak). loom-serve gets a 15e9-byte budget (16 GiB board minus ~2 GiB for the desktop session and driver), matching the gfx1201-16gb convention. Measured on a Radeon RX 7800 XT (soulafein83's machine, CachyOS, Linux 7.3.4, ROCm 10.1): VRAM total 17163091968 B (16 GiB), 16.98 GiB free at idle, 6.01 GiB used serving Gemma-4-E4B-it Q4_K_M (ctx 73728, rows 4, draft_depth 3) with --state_slab_bytes=4mib --weight_slab_bytes=64mib. amdf-info (hrx-loom 0.2.0, ABI 20) reports only a system memory pool for this device (Locality unavailable); the budget is an explicit --memory_bytes argument, not derived from an enumerated pool

radeon-rx7800xt.name: AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (gfx1101, 16 GB)
radeon-rx7800xt.note: bw SPEC (not measured): GDDR6 19.5 Gbps, 256-bit = 624 GB/s peak (AMD spec). flops SPEC: 60 CUs, 37.3 TFLOP/s dense f16 WMMA (AMD spec). A DevLab measurement would replace both. Measured (this session, hrx-loom 0.2.0, 2026-11-18): decode 170.5 tok/s (82.6% of the 206.4 tok/s bandwidth ceiling), prefill 1k/2k/8k/16k/32k = 3934/4482/4227/3947/3270 tok/s, 4 streams 329.1 tok/s aggregate, golden PASS (23 prompts, 16 full match, max gap 0.205, bad=0), spec 16/16 (acceptance 42%), ctx_admit 73653/73728, VRAM 6.01 GB at peak
